review.summary: Material review makes the panel problem clear: the main wood face has fragmented irregular grooves rather than a clean repeated slat rhythm, while the reverse has a large projecting radiator-like board stack and broken horizontal strips. The countertop/frame are usable but this panel construction is not accepted.

issues.problem: Irregular fragmented front slats and incoherent projecting reverse panels remain after texturing.

review.summary: Counter retains broad flat countertop, end supports, inset front panel and plinth with the reference overall proportions. Material review must confirm the decorative slat appearance.

issues.problem: Front grooves are shallow/irregular and the unshown reverse has inferred asymmetric service panels/vent-like detail. These remain visible source differences to assess with texture.

review.summary: Reduced counter retains flat stone top, dark end/plinth frame and coherent wood-slat material on both faces. Five-view source comparison shows no major new PBR distortion; neutral-only faceting is compensated by the retained normal map. Fresh FBX/GLB pass at 13,432 triangles.

issues.problem: Minor edge/wood-detail softening, weak under-counter glow and inferred reverse handles remain.

review.summary: Second counter texture establishes a coherent repeated vertical wood-slat finish, light stone top and dark end/plinth panels. The reverse is a consistent cabinet face with two small handles rather than the prior projecting stack.

issues.problem: Less prominent warm under-counter glow, minor wood pits and inferred rear handles differ from the reference.

review.summary: Second counter retains the flat top, end supports and inset panels while removing the large projecting reverse board stack. Reverse reads as coherent cabinet doors with two small handles.

issues.problem: Fine shallow front grooves, small surface pits and inferred reverse door handles remain; texture must establish a coherent slatted wood finish.
